purpose: Completed manual evaluation of single-pass baseline run baseline-001 on reference video 6718335390845095173.

run_metadata.evaluator: manual frame-by-frame review (ffmpeg 1fps extraction + ffprobe facts)

media_facts.notes: Duration claim close; resolution/fps correctly left null rather than guessed.
media_facts.evidence: Claimed duration_seconds_claimed=10.0 vs ffprobe Duration=00:00:10.50 (0.5s / ~5% error). resolution_claimed/fps_claimed=null; actual 720x1280@30fps.

shot_boundaries_timeline.notes: Ordering and per-shot content match the extracted frames at each second; boundaries quantized to whole seconds.
shot_boundaries_timeline.evidence: Frames f_01..f_10 confirm: boat dog(0-1), poolside walk(~2), towel close-up(~3), blur transition(~4), running to camera(~5), hand splash(~6), fish scene(~7), swim(~8-9), boat wake(~9-10). Uniform 1s segmentation suggests coarse boundary estimation.

visible_text_ocr.notes: Returned visible_text=[] but a legible brand text appears on the yellow towel.
visible_text_ocr.evidence: 'CHILLY PAD' circular logo plus partial 'cooling...' text clearly legible on the towel in frame f_03 (~2-3s); omitted entirely.

dialogue.notes: No spoken dialogue present; model correctly returned empty dialogue without invention.
dialogue.evidence: Audio is music only (metadata music_title='original sound'); output dialogue=[].

visual_description.notes: Subjects, actions, setting accurate across all sampled frames; one accessory mislabel.
visual_description.evidence: Dog described as wearing 'pink harness' in shot 2; it is a pink collar (also seen shots 1,7). Boat/pool/towel/fish/wake descriptions all match frames.

camera_editing.notes: Framing/movement per shot plausible and consistent with frames; transitions incl. whip-blur captured.
camera_editing.evidence: Low-angle tracking (shot 2), close-up (shot 3), motion-blur move (shot 4), high-angle rear wake view (shot 9) all match; 'hard cut' transitions consistent with distinct scenes per second.

audio.notes: Conservative presence claims; no invented track/artist. One over-specific descriptor.
audio.evidence: music_presence='present', voiceover='none', sfx=[] are safe; 'vocal music track' asserts vocals that cannot be confirmed from review and metadata only says 'original sound'.

hook.notes: Hook evidence grounded in first shot; mechanism inference reasonable.
hook.evidence: First frame: fluffy black-and-white dog standing on boat seat facing camera, mouth open/panting - matches output description; 'cute animal engages pet lovers' is a sound inference.

narrative.notes: Montage structure and semantic roles correctly inferred; no story arc invented.
narrative.evidence: Output calls it a 'high-energy summer pet adventure montage'; frames support loose activity montage rather than narrative arc.

marketing_commercial_reasoning.notes: Returning commercial_mechanisms=[] is defensible visually, but misses the engagement-bait CTA evident from source metadata/caption.
marketing_commercial_reasoning.evidence: Caption: 'Scramble up ur name & I'll try to guess it' = comment-bait CTA; model saw the caption in source metadata yet inferred no persuasion mechanism.

reconstruction_quality.notes: Per-shot instructions cover all 9 shots in order; a creator could approximately rebuild the montage.
reconstruction_quality.evidence: Each generation.per_shot_instruction maps 1:1 to an observed shot; global instruction captures 10s pet montage + lively music.

unsupported_claims.claim: Music described as 'Upbeat cheerful vocal music track'
unsupported_claims.why_unsupported: Vocals not verifiable from review pass; source metadata only identifies 'original sound'. Over-specified beyond observation.
Emotional-state attribution beyond what is visually observable; open-mouth appearance is observable, happiness is inferred inside observed.* fields.
Accessory is a collar, not a harness, in reviewed frames.

missed_important_facts.fact: 'CHILLY PAD' brand logo/text on yellow towel
missed_important_facts.impact: Loses product-branding signal relevant to creative analysis; exact-text extraction is a core CreativeIR requirement.

missed_important_facts.fact: Engagement-bait CTA from caption ('Scramble up ur name & I'll try to guess it')
missed_important_facts.impact: Misses the video's primary comment-driving persuasion loop.
Minor; within 5%, acceptable for a no-preprocessing baseline.

top_weaknesses: No deterministic media preprocessing: duration misestimated and shot boundaries quantized to uniform 1-second slices.
Exact on-screen text extraction failed (missed legible 'CHILLY PAD' branding).
Single pass cannot combine source-metadata signals (caption CTA) with visual evidence into persuasion analysis.
